Profile: High-value, frequent, and recent buyers across many categories.
Top Tactic 1: Invite to exclusive VIP loyalty program with early access to sales.
Top Tactic 2: Personalized recommendations based on cross-category purchase history.
KPIs: CLV (Customer Lifetime Value), Repeat purchase rate, NPS score
Risk: Churn if they feel undervalued — invest in retention proactively.

Profile: Consistent, moderate spenders with stable purchase rhythms.
Top Tactic 1: Points-based loyalty rewards to reinforce habitual purchasing.
Top Tactic 2: Bundle offers to increase average order value.
KPIs: Frequency, Average order value growth, Promotion redemption rate
Risk: May switch to competitor on price — maintain competitive pricing.

Profile: Long since last purchase; historically low engagement.
Top Tactic 1: Win-back campaign: 'We miss you' email with 20–30% one-time discount.
Top Tactic 2: Survey to understand reasons for disengagement.
KPIs: Reactivation rate, Campaign ROI, Email open rate
Risk: High acquisition cost per win-back — prioritize highest-LTV churned customers.

Profile: Irregular, high-variance spend — typically triggered by promotions or seasonal events.
Top Tactic 1: Flash sales and limited-time offers timed to known peaks.
Top Tactic 2: Retargeting ads showing recently viewed items.
KPIs: Conversion rate on promotions, Return rate, Campaign click-through
Risk: Heavy discounting erodes margins — segment further by LTV before offering deep discounts.

Profile: Regular but modest spenders, price-sensitive, limited category diversity.
KPIs: Basket size, Coupon redemption, Category expansion rate
Risk: Thin margins — focus on volume and basket growth rather than discounting.
